description: One schema of the same Instance in Env A (left) and Env B (right): tables and indexes, objects of one env only and row count differences. Table regex narrows it to some tables. Source: ClickHouse pg_monitoring (dual write).

panels.description: Tables of the schema in both envs, last n_live_tup and total size. delta = B - A, delta_pct = delta / A; sorted by |delta|. Objects of one env only: see the Only in panels.

targets.rawSql: SELECT datname, schemaname, relname, rows_a, rows_b, rows_b - rows_a AS delta, delta / nullIf(rows_a, 0) AS delta_pct, size_a, size_b, size_b - size_a AS size_delta FROM (SELECT datname, schemaname, relname, anyIf(rows, env = ${env_a:singlequote}) AS rows_a, anyIf(rows, env = ${env_b:singlequote}) AS rows_b, anyIf(size, env = ${env_a:singlequote}) AS size_a, anyIf(size, env = ${env_b:singlequote}) AS size_b, countIf(env = ${env_a:singlequote}) AS n_a, countIf(env = ${env_b:singlequote}) AS n_b FROM (SELECT datname, schemaname, relname, env, c_rows AS rows, c_size AS size FROM (SELECT datname, schemaname, relname, env, argMax(n_live_tup, time) AS c_rows, argMax(total_bytes, time) AS c_size FROM pg_monitoring.pg_table_stat WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND env IN (${env_a:singlequote}, ${env_b:singlequote}) AND db_instance = ${db_instance:singlequote} AND $__conditionalAll(datname IN (${datname:singlequote}), $datname) AND schemaname = ${schemaname:singlequote} AND match(relname, concat('^(', ${relname:sqlstring}, ')$')) GROUP BY datname, schemaname, relname, env)) GROUP BY datname, schemaname, relname) WHERE n_a > 0 AND n_b > 0 ORDER BY abs(delta) DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT *, dml / nullIf(sum(dml) OVER (), 0) AS share_pct FROM (SELECT datname, schemaname, relname, c_ins AS ins, c_upd AS upd, c_del AS del, c_hot_upd AS hot_upd, ins + upd + del AS dml FROM (SELECT datname, schemaname, relname, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_ins)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_ins)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_ins, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_upd)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_upd)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_upd, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_del)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_del)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_del, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_hot_upd)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_hot_upd)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_hot_upd FROM pg_monitoring.pg_table_stat WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND env = ${env_a:singlequote} AND db_instance = ${db_instance:singlequote} AND $__conditionalAll(datname IN (${datname:singlequote}), $datname) AND schemaname = ${schemaname:singlequote} AND match(relname, concat('^(', ${relname:sqlstring}, ')$')) GROUP BY datname, schemaname, relname))
